activeQuestion.prompt: A session is booked for 2 p.m. The lead cannot arrive until 2:20, and the booking app is not working. What can keep the room reservation?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 一場展示預約在下午 2 點開始。負責人得等到 2:20 才能到場，預約應用程式也無法使用。如何保留房間預約？

options.text: The lead checks in at the panel immediately after arriving.
options.zh: 負責人抵達後立刻使用門外面板報到。
options.whyZh: 面板確實可用，但下午 2:20 已超過開場後十分鐘的報到期限。

options.text: The listed co-host uses the panel at 2:07.
options.zh: 已登記的共同主持人在下午 2:07 使用面板報到。
options.whyZh: 已登記的共同主持人可以代為報到。應用程式無法使用時，可改用門外面板，而 2:07 在十分鐘期限內。

options.text: An unlisted colleague opens the client’s meeting link at 2:05.
options.zh: 未登記為共同主持人的同事在下午 2:05 開啟客戶的會議連結。
options.whyZh: 只有負責人或已登記的共同主持人能報到；開啟會議連結也不等於報到。

options.text: The listed co-host lets clients into the room before 2:10 without marking it as in use.
options.zh: 已登記的共同主持人於下午 2:10 前讓客戶進門，但未將房間標記為使用中。
options.whyZh: 雖是有資格代辦的人，但只讓客戶進門並不算報到。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 已登記的共同主持人可以代為報到。應用程式無法使用時，可改用門外面板，而 2:07 在十分鐘期限內。
activeQuestion.evidence: a colleague who is already listed as a co-host […] ten minutes after the reserved start […] can use the panel outside the room instead

vocabulary.note: 本文限定已在預約內登記的人，並非在場的任何同事。

group.title: Thursday client demonstration: room and arrival instructions
group.titleZh: 週四客戶展示：場地與入場須知
group.passage:
Thursday client demonstration: room and arrival instructions

All three demonstration rooms have a display. Harbor can send both picture and sound to remote viewers, but there are three steps from the elevator to its door. Grove and Shore are both accessible without steps. Grove can send sound to remote viewers but has no camera; a portable camera that can be aimed at the demonstration table will be available there after 1 p.m. Shore sends sound and picture throughout the day, but its camera is fixed on the presenter’s lectern. It cannot show a product on the demonstration table.

Outside technicians should bring the equipment collection reference to the service entrance if they are collecting any demonstration equipment from our storeroom. If they need nothing from the storeroom and are bringing their own equipment, they should use the lobby and show the vendor confirmation email. A supplier’s delivery driver who is not staying for the session should use the loading dock instead; a delivery note is enough there. The desk in the lobby does not issue collection references.

The session lead must mark the room as in use in the booking app. If the lead will be more than ten minutes late, a colleague who is already listed as a co-host can do this on arrival. If neither person has checked in ten minutes after the reserved start, the room will go to the waiting list. Letting the client into the room or opening the meeting link does not count as room check-in. If the booking app is not working, the lead or listed co-host can use the panel outside the room instead.
group.passageZh:
週四客戶展示：場地與入場須知

三間展示室都有螢幕。Harbor 可將畫面和聲音傳給遠端觀眾，但從電梯到門口有三級階梯。前往 Grove 和 Shore 的路線都沒有階梯。Grove 能傳送聲音給遠端觀眾，但沒有攝影機。下午一點後，該室便可使用一台可對準展示桌的可攜式攝影機。Shore 全天都能傳送聲音和畫面，但攝影機固定對準講台，只能拍攝講台前的講者，無法拍到展示桌上的產品。

外部技術人員若要到本公司庫房領取任何展示設備，請攜帶領取編號前往服務入口。若自備設備且不必到庫房領取任何物品，請走大廳入口並出示供應商確認信。不會留下參與展示的送貨司機則應前往卸貨區，在那裡只需出示送貨單。大廳櫃檯不核發設備領取編號。

展示負責人必須在預約應用程式中將房間標記為使用中。如果負責人會遲到超過十分鐘，預約中已登記為共同主持人的同事可在到場時代為報到。若預約時段開始十分鐘後兩人都未報到，房間就會釋出給候補者。讓客戶進入展示室，或開啟線上會議連結，都不算完成房間報到。如果預約應用程式無法使用，負責人或已登記的共同主持人可以改用房間門外的面板。

originalQuestion.prompt: How can a user identify a room equipped for video conferences?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 如何辨識配有視訊會議設備的房間？

options.text: Check whether the reservation includes external visitors
options.zh: 查看預約是否包含外部訪客
options.whyZh: 外部訪客人數用於準備識別證，不能辨識視訊設備。

options.text: Choose any room with an ordinary screen
options.zh: 選任何有一般螢幕的房間
options.whyZh: 文件明說一般螢幕不代表有攝影機。

options.zh: 查看是否有攝影機圖示
options.whyZh: 通知最後一段說，配有視訊會議設備的房間會標示攝影機圖示。

options.text: Look for a check-in panel outside the room
options.zh: 查看門外是否有報到面板
options.whyZh: 門外面板用來報到，不是視訊設備的標記。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 通知最後一段說，配有視訊會議設備的房間會標示攝影機圖示。
originalQuestion.evidence: Rooms with video-conferencing equipment are marked with a camera icon
